chunks: Fear Allah every morning and evening
and remain apprehensive about yourself of this deceitful world and do not regard it safe in any case
Know that if for fear of some evil you do not refrain yourself from things which you love, then passions will fling you into a lot of harm
Therefore, be for yourself a refrainer and protector, and for your anger a suppressor and killer

key_terms.الْحَفِيظَة: the guardian / protector (often referring to God or the inner self)

ai.seo_question: How does Imam Ali advise controlling the self and worldly desires?
ai.summary: Delivered to military commanders, this advice highlights the psychological discipline required for leadership, framing the self (nafs) as a battlefield where desires must be curbed to prevent spiritual harm. It underscores the Shia concept of *muraqabah* (watchfulness), urging believers to be both the guardian and the suppressor of their own impulses, ensuring that worldly allurements do not distract from divine duty.

en.sayed-ali-raza: Fear Allāh every morning and evening
and remain apprehensive about yourself of this deceitful world and do not regard it safe in any case.
Know that if for fear of some evil you do not refrain yourself from things which you love, then passions will fling you into a lot of harm.
Therefore, be for yourself a refrainer and protector, and for your anger a suppressor and killer.
